system.longDesc:
Requirement: Fire Arcana (Master)

Cost: 11 PP

Time: Major action

Target Number: 15

Test: Dexterity (Acrobatics) vs. Force

You create an explosive firestorm with a 4-yard radius anywhere within 50 yards of you. Anyone in the area takes 3d6 + Willpower damage and may be knocked prone. Those who make a successful Dexterity (Acrobatics) test vs. your Force remain standing.
